rationale: direction_sign is the spine's sign: 1 favourable, -1 unfavourable for risk appetite or the named entity (references/typing_prompt_v1.txt rule 8). Textbook monetary transmission. A hawkish surprise is unfavourable (-1) and raises rates_expectation (- edge, so a negative sign raises it); higher expected rates lower long-duration bond prices (rates_expectation -> TLT -), tighten risk_appetite (-) and strengthen the dollar (UUP +); risk appetite moves equities and high-yield credit in the same direction (SPY +, HYG +). Documentation, not data.
